reader_summary.headline: Donald Miller explains how to use story structure to make customers listen to your business message.
reader_summary.overview: Donald Miller is the CEO of StoryBrand and author of ten books on storytelling. His latest book, Building a Storybrand 2.0, teaches how to clarify your message so customers will listen. The conversation covers seven elements of story structure and how to use them effectively.

key_points.text: Donald Miller teaches seven elements of story structure to help businesses clarify their message so customers will listen.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our conversation covers Don's most important lessons in telling a story that resonates with customers, including the seven elements of story structure and key components of each.

key_points.text: He recently launched storybrand.ai, a free tool that can write your tagline in seven minutes using his insights.
key_points.evidence_quote: He recently launched storybrand.ai , a free LLM trained on 120 pages of his insights. In just seven minutes, you can have Don write your tagline.

reader_summary.why_it_matters: Listeners learn how to apply story structure to make their business message resonate with customers.

notes: Donald Miller is the CEO of StoryBrand and author of ten books that have collectively spent more than a year on New York Times Bestseller lists. Don helps businesses clarify their message so customers will listen. His latest book, Building a Storybrand 2.0, is a revised edition of one of the most succinct, impactful, and actionable books I've come across on storytelling. Our conversation covers Don's most important lessons in telling a story that resonates with customers, including the seven elements of story structure and key components of each. Don wants to share his gift for taglines with you. He recently launched storybrand.ai , a free LLM trained on 120 pages of his insights. In just seven minutes, you can have Don write your tagline.  About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
